_doc: Every vehicle's numbers. Frame: +z forward, +y up, +x = the LEFT side. Units: metres, kg, newtons. Wheel p = hub position with the suspension fully extended. Seats: p = where the rider's HIPS go (or the FEET when stand: true); pose = the Chibi 2.6 clip: 'drive' (hands on a wheel / yoke / stick), 'seated' (passengers, benches), 'ride' (astride: bikes, quad), 'idle' (standing); feet = [half, y, fwd]: soles at height y (vehicle frame: floor / footwell / peg / deck top), fwd m ahead of the hips along the seat's facing, half m either side, or 'pedals' (the model's pedals); hands 'wheel' | 'bars' | gun, or grips [[x,y,z],[x,y,z]] + gripFrame 'body'|'steer'|'bars'|'yaw'|'pitch'; wheelAt / barsAt = where the model puts the wheel / grips; exit = where you step out (x, z vehicle frame; y from the seat). Built for Chibi 2.6 riders (Expansion 1 M1, measured by tools/measure-rider.mjs, metres over the floor under the feet): default human 1.733 tall; drive hips 0.447, eye 1.078, head top 1.34, shoulders 0.824 (0.456 wide), fists ~0.17 over / ~0.52 ahead of the hips; seated hips 0.450, eye 1.086; ride hips 0.90 (= standing); standing hips 0.909, eye 1.546, shoulders 1.286. Across the races: head top 0.69-0.98 over the hips, arm 0.42-0.75, leg 0.70-0.85, ankle 0.075. So: roofs / cages at hips + ~1.0, wheel centre ~0.3 over and ~0.42 ahead of the hips, car footwells 0.22-0.27 under the hips (legs out), chair cabs 0.42-0.45, standing gun grips ~1.1 over the feet. riders.js pins the hip bone on p for any race and slides a short-armed driver forward instead of stretching.
